verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies page says it advises both startups and the venture capital and institutional partners that finance them. It also cites hundreds of financings a year, which supports the core of the story: the firm sits on both sides of venture deals. The Automated Convertible Note's 'customizable market standard terms' adds modest support for market-terms awareness, but all evidence is first-party marketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fund-side work (fund formation or LP/GP representation), any published market-terms data or survey showing current deal terms, and independent corroboration of investor-side representation.
